text:
Olivia: Final GA snapshot thread. Need to lock the production-readiness rubric before tomorrow's cut: SLA wording, monitoring golden signals, pricing kill-switch, docs + customer escalation, and the 14-day warm support plan. Assign owners?

Jamal: I'll take monitoring + alerts. Golden signals: p95 latency by route, sustained 5xx %, cache_hit_rate, and token-cost-per-minute. Add anomaly detector: if token-cost deviates >30% vs baseline for 10m, page oncall.

Priya: Pricing owner. Proposal: simple per-token rate with an opt-in pilot coupon for early enterprise customers (valid 90 days). Add a manual "billing freeze" switch for pilot accounts if we detect divergent billing. Need FinOps sign-off.

Hector: SLA & support. Draft SLA tiers: Standard (99.5% uptime, email support, 48h P2), Business (99.8%, 8h P1), Enterprise (99.95%, 2h P1 + account manager). Also publishing a one-page "How to escalate" that lists contacts and expected response times.

Olivia: Docs: we need quickstart (JS/Python), streaming example with reconnect/backoff, and a short troubleshooting table. Also a small migration note for dedicated customers moving from beta endpoints.

Jamal: Alerts to wire: `p95_latency > 400ms for 5m`, `rate(5xx) > 0.5% for 10m`, `cache_hit_rate < 50% for 15m`, and `token_cost_delta > 30% for 10m`. I'll attach a Grafana dashboard JSON in the PR.

Priya: Action: I'll drop a draft pricing table here by EOD. Need typical tokens/request from engineering to model revenue scenarios. @Jamal please share median/95th token sizes.

Hector: For support ops: propose 24/5 coverage for GA, with a single dedicated responder each weekday for first 14 days. Escalation to Eng-SRE for infra and to Oncall-ML for model-quality regressions.

Olivia: Scope decision: cut advanced custom quantization workflows and deprioritize autoscale-by-latency for GA. Marking both as "alpha" and adding migration notes. Any objections?

Priya: Agree. Keep billing and contracts simple at GA.

Jamal: Small technical ask: include a fallback routing policy in the runbook — if p95 latency > 350ms for 3 consecutive checks, route new requests to a smaller model variant. I'll draft the route-config snippet.

Olivia: Good. Also add a PR checklist for launch PRs: 1) SLA doc link, 2) runbook link, 3) monitoring dashboard link, 4) pricing table link, 5) customer escalation doc link. All must be green before we cut.

Hector: I'll coordinate legal wording for SLA credits and add the escalation contact matrix.

devrel-bot: Canary deploy scheduled tomorrow 04:00 UTC. Reminder: run synthetic streaming smoke, verify token accounting, and run the customer-facing quickstart.

Priya: Noted. I'll ping FinOps and attach the pricing stub when ready.

Jamal: I'll upload dashboard + alert rules and include the rollback steps in the runbook (how to flip route and revert model).

Olivia: Owners recap: Monitoring/alerts + dashboards 1 Jamal; Pricing 1 Priya; SLA + support playbook 1 Hector; Docs + quickstart 1 Olivia. If we have all checklist items linked 12h before canary we proceed.

Hector: One last ask: add a short customer-facing "priority support 1 how it works" page. I'll draft and hand to DevRel for review.

Olivia: Thanks all. I'll send the owners email and lock deadlines.
